question: How are the nine-self and triad arranged?
premises: Nine-self; on left that devī-like Bhairava triad.
In middle supreme full-moon image; on right again.
inference: The arrangement places the triad on the left, supreme full-moon image in the middle, and again on the right.
plain_english: Nine-self; on the left that devī-like Bhairava triad; in the middle supreme full-moon image; on the right again.
